verdict.rationale: Warp's privacy docs say users can opt out of telemetry at any time, list every telemetry event, and offer a Network Log to watch telemetry live. For an AI-native user there is a significant caveat: on the Free plan, telemetry must stay on to use AI features, so a full opt-out with AI is limited to paid plans (Business and Enterprise add Zero Data Retention). Missing for 10: opt-out with AI on the Free plan, documented steps or controls for the opt-out, independent or hands-on confirmation that opting out stops tracking.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking

citations.quote: Opt out of telemetry at any time
Telemetry must be enabled to use AI features on the Free plan, while paid plans can opt out at any time and continue using Warp, including AI.
Read a complete list of all the telemetry events that get sent for app analytics
Monitor telemetry in real-time with Warp’s native Network Log
No AI interaction or console data is ever collected.
